WITH ab_trans_trader AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    t.tradekind
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
),
counts_by_trans_type AS (
  SELECT 
    transreg,
    tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as trans_count
  FROM ab_trans_trader
  GROUP BY transreg, tradekind
),
with_total AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    trans_count,
    CAST(trans_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(trans_count) OVER () as share
  FROM counts_by_trans_type
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(trans_count) as avg_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share
FROM with_total
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind
